brief:
A young Palestinian doctor who survived Israel's war on Gaza has described the burden of providing patient care amid widespread death, displacement, and disease, Middle East Eye reported. The doctor's account details confronting medical responsibilities in conditions of active bombardment and the toll on healthcare workers operating in the territory.

Gaza's medical system faced severe strain during the conflict, with healthcare workers attempting to treat casualties while managing their own displacement and safety concerns.

title: Gaza doctor describes treating patients amid Israeli bombardment
